Rule.Name: RxdkXboxBuild
Rule.Description: Compile/build settings for the Xbox title.

EnumProperty.Name: RxdkBuildFlavor
EnumProperty.Description: Whether this configuration builds Debug (unoptimized -O0, debug info, debug SDK libs) or Release (optimized, release SDK libs). Defaults from the configuration name; set it explicitly for a custom configuration.

EnumProperty.Name: RxdkReleaseOptimize
EnumProperty.Description: Zig optimize mode used when the Build Flavor is Release. Ignored for Debug (always -O0 with debug info).

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkDefines
StringListProperty.Description: Extra preprocessor macros passed to the compiler (in addition to the built-in _XBOX;XBOX). One per entry, e.g. MY_FLAG or NAME=VALUE.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkLibraries
StringListProperty.Description: SDK libraries linked into the title (order matters; libkernel is forced last automatically). e.g. libd3d8;libd3dx8;libxapi;libc;libcpp;libkernel.
